messages:
mike-sales: ACME ran a geo-demo and hit intermittent 5xxs when we attempted cross-region failover. They called it a blocker for tomorrow's board demo. Can SE + ops triage?

anya-se: What errors/codes and which region? Any request ids?

mike-sales: They captured: 
```
2026-05-05T18:22:10Z 503 Service Unavailable req=gr_c3p9
2026-05-05T18:22:11Z 504 Gateway Timeout req=gr_c3pa
```
Spike originated in eu-west-1, we attempted failover to us-west-2.

frank-ops: ops-bot pulled infra metrics. Summary: eu-west-1 serving pool saturated (queued=280), failover routing started at 18:22:05 but target pool in us-west-2 had cold nodes and model load delay ~55s. Many requests queued and expired -> 504/503.

ops-bot: AUTOMATED: logs for req=gr_c3p9 -> enqueue -> remote_route_attempt -> remote_pool_full -> queue_drop -> 503. Collected 30 lines.

sophia-runtime: Two quick options: (A) temporary throttling at edge to smooth the ramp (rate limit to 120 rps for 60s) while warm nodes spin up, or (B) enable burst_pool for eu-west-1 with small cap and disable cross-region failover for the demo so traffic stays local and autoscaler scales there.

anya-se: Customer worried about cross-region latency impact. Sales prefers option B (keep local but allow burst). They'll accept a small capped burst for demo.

frank-ops: I'll enable burst_pool in eu-west-1 with cap=8k tokens and set a temporary routing rule to prefer local redwood-v1-quant if queue_depth>70. Commands: 
```
infractl config set --project acme-poc eu-west-1.burst.enabled=true eu-west-1.burst.cap=8000
infractl routing add --project acme-poc --rule "eu-west-1.queue>70 => redwood-v1-quant@eu-west-1"
```
Applying now.

ops-bot: CONFIG: eu-west-1.burst.enabled=true cap=8000 by frank-ops at 2026-05-05T18:28:20Z

sophia-runtime: Also bumping autoscale aggressiveness for eu-west-1 (scale_threshold 55 -> 45, warm_spare=1) to reduce next spinup time. Will rollback after demo window.

mike-sales: Please capture request ids if anything recurs and send a short note about burst billing. I'll inform ACME and confirm the demo path. Thanks team.

frank-ops: Monitor turned on for queue_depth>150, pager enabled. Closing for now, will report back after the 19:00 demo.
